data.summary: The review profile is highly suspicious. A contractor with only one extremely brief, generic 5-star review and no presence on any other review platform (BBB, Angi, Houzz, Yelp) is a major red flag. This pattern is more indicative of a new, unestablished, or potentially fake business profile than an authentic contractor with a customer base. The single review provides no verifiable details about a project, timeline, crew, or specific outcome.

Single review is generic and lacks detail
